QuestInfo.name: Collecting Debts
QuestInfo.0: Gen's ledger lists three outstanding debts that need to be collected. But who should you start with?
QuestInfo.1: You decide to collect the debts from the ledger in the order they're listed. First #bGusto#k from the #bBlack Market,#k then #bCorbo#k at the #b#m402000100#,#k and finally #bAntuin#k from the #bPawn Shop.#k
QuestInfo.2: Antuin in Brigand's Row obstinately insists he wants to pay his debts, but that he doesn't have the money at the moment.

0.0: I might as well pay everyone a visit in the order of the names in the ledger. First up: #bGusto#k from the Black Market.\r\n

no.0: Ugh, I feel like I'm forgetting something...\r\n

0.msg: Look, I know you haven't had any customers for quite a while. So, why don't you just give me whatever you've got in the safe, okay?\r\n

1.msg: You've got a sharp eye. So, you're one of those Shadowdealers too, huh? Well, you can go ahead and skip the thinly-veiled threats. Inside the safe, there's more than enough to pay my debt. However...\r\n

2.msg: There's one problem... I don't know the combination! Look, if you can crack the safe, I'll p-pay you from the money inside. That's f-fair, isn't it?\r\n
